name: Gavilanes (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gavilanes (hawks on yellow and roundels on blue).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 19 June 1986 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 72 of 30 June 1986); the flag is crimson, charged at the centre with the municipal heraldic arms.
